articles.summary: Horizon anticipates releasing its financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, before the financial markets open.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum to Report Second Quarter Financial Results on August 4, 2026

articles.summary: Today, Horizon Quantum announced a strategic collaboration with QM to increase the efficiency of quantum systems through the development of embedded calibration technologies designed to reduce downtime and improve operational stability.
articles.title: Horizon Quantum and Quantum Machines Announce Strategic Collaboration to Increase Efficiency of Quantum Systems
